prompts.text_original: Pin a country or territory where a new temple was announced at the April 2019 general conference.
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org temple milestones, read 27 Oct 2026; Church Newsroom conference temple announcement

prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose Church missionary training center closed between 2019 and 2023
prompts.text_original: Between 2019 and 2023 the Church closed several missionary training centers outside the United States as more missionaries trained at home or online. A country whose missionary training center closed in that period.
prompts.citation: Church News 2019-02-08; Newsroom (Guatemala MTC, Colombia MTC)
prompts.summary: In 2019 the Church closed its training centers in Santiago, Madrid and Santo Domingo, then Buenos Aires that July. Guatemala City followed in January 2020 and Bogota in January 2023. Missionaries from those lands now train at home, online or at the remaining centers.

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: The Buenos Aires MTC closed in July 2019.

answers.name: Chile
answers.fact: The Santiago MTC closed in January 2019.

answers.name: Spain
answers.fact: The Madrid MTC closed in January 2019.

answers.name: Colombia
answers.fact: The Bogota MTC closed in January 2023.

answers.name: Dominican Republic
answers.fact: The Santo Domingo MTC closed in January 2019.

answers.name: Guatemala
answers.fact: The Guatemala City MTC closed in January 2020.

prompts.display_text: Pin the homeland of a language (not Arabic) whose first Book of Mormon, whole or in part, came out in 1980
prompts.text_original: A country that is the home of a language, other than Arabic, in which the Book of Mormon was first published, in selections or in full, in 1980
prompts.citation: Church translations table, Book of Mormon; Church News, 27 Feb 2022; Global Histories chronology: Fiji
prompts.note: Arabic, also first published in 1980 as selections, is left out so the list stays closed. Russian is dated 1981 by Church News.
prompts.summary: The year 1980 brought the Book of Mormon into six new languages, mostly as selections that were completed later. Besides Arabic they were Bulgarian, Navajo, Ecuadorian Quichua, Vietnamese and Fijian, whose first 50 copies reached Suva that October.

answers.name: Fiji
answers.fact: Fijian, 1980; the first 50 copies reached Suva on 29 October 1980.

answers.name: Vietnam
answers.fact: Vietnamese selections came out in 1980 and the full book in 1982.

answers.name: Bulgaria
answers.fact: Bulgarian selections came out in 1980 and the full book in 1999.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Navajo selections came out in 1980 and the full book in 1998.

answers.name: Ecuador
answers.fact: Quichua (Ecuador) selections came out in 1980 and the full book in 2011.

prompts.display_text: Pin a Northern European country whose first stake (a group of congregations) came 1960-1977 (Northern Ireland counts as UK)
prompts.text_original: Stakes came to Europe in 1960 and spread north over the next two decades. A country in Northern Europe (the Nordic and Baltic countries, the United Kingdom and Ireland) whose first stake was organized between 1960 and 1977.
prompts.note: Ireland's first stake came in 1995. Belfast's 1974 stake is in the United Kingdom, which already had stakes.
prompts.summary: Europe's first stake was organized in Manchester, England, in 1960. Scandinavia followed in the 1970s: Copenhagen in 1974, Stockholm in 1975, and Oslo and Helsinki in 1977. Ireland waited until 1995, and Iceland and the Baltic states still have districts rather than stakes as of October 2026.

answers.name: United Kingdom
answers.fact: The Manchester England Stake, the first stake in Europe, was organized March 27, 1960.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: The Copenhagen Denmark Stake, the first in Scandinavia, was organized June 16, 1974.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: The Stockholm Sweden Stake was organized April 20, 1975.

answers.name: Norway
answers.fact: The Oslo Norway Stake, Norway's first, was created May 22, 1977.

answers.name: Finland
answers.fact: The Helsinki Finland Stake, Finland's first, was organized October 16, 1977.

prompts.display_text: Pin an Asian country or territory where a current General Authority Seventy served as a young full-time missionary.
prompts.text_original: Several General Authority Seventies serving as of October 2026 were once young full-time missionaries in Asia. Pin an Asian country or territory where one of them served, as named in the Church's official biographies.
prompts.citation: Church leader biographies, General Authority Seventies, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: As of October 2026, the biographies of current General Authority Seventies name young missions in Japan, South Korea, the Philippines, Hong Kong and Thailand. Elder Kelly R. Johnson later returned to the Thailand Bangkok Mission with his wife as mission leaders.

answers.name: Japan
answers.fact: Japan Kobe, Fukuoka and Tokyo North missions (Elders Esplin, McKay, McCune, Whiting).

answers.name: South Korea
answers.fact: Korea Seoul and Busan missions (Elders Rasband, Ringwood, Choi).

answers.name: Philippines
answers.fact: Philippines Bacolod and Cebu, Cagayan de Oro, and Davao missions (Elders Revillo, Fantone, Teh).

answers.name: Hong Kong
answers.fact: China Hong Kong Mission (Elders Homer and Wu).

answers.name: Taiwan
answers.fact: Elder Anthony D. Perkins served his young mission in Taiwan.

answers.name: Thailand
answers.fact: Thailand Bangkok Mission (Elder Kelly R. Johnson).
